verdicts.id: packages/better-auth/src/plugins/admin/admin.test.ts::Admin plugin > should revalidate useSession after admin impersonation
verdicts.reason: It checks only the outcome the instruction asks for: after impersonateUser, a useSession subscriber gets the impersonated user's id. It uses only public client interfaces (useSession, getSession, admin.impersonateUser) plus test helpers that already existed, and inspects no internals.
